mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as elevated labor market stress reduces growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or returns revert within 5 days post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) proxies signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce significantly higher returns than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: During a 'monetary easing cycle', a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as lower borrowing costs boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: In 'monetary easing cycles', 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 indicates stronger supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases do not correlate with significantly higher 20-day returns (p > 0.05) in a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) crosses above 105, it signals a supply-side expansion that generates positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are not significantly positive within 5 days post-INDPRO crossing (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in job growth (PAYEMS) proxies indicates a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Combined UNRATE and PAYEMS changes do not lead to significantly higher returns than baseline (p > 0.05) over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, a drop in housing demand (HOUST) below its 12-month low predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates peak normalization.
failure_condition: In 'late-cycle expansion' regimes, HOUST drops do not predict significantly positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05).
